name: Venity Network
description:
Venity Network is a Minecraft Bedrock server network that features multiple game modes, including BedWars, SkyWars, TheBridge, CrystalPvP, Fireball Fight, BedFight, and Duels.

Game Modes & Features:

• BedWars – Team up or solo to protect your bed while trying to destroy your enemies’ beds.

• SkyWars – Battle other players on floating islands until one remains standing.

• TheBridge – Fast 1v1 or 2v2 on narrow bridges where speed and skill dominate.

• CrystalPvP – Intense PvP mode focused on quick combat and strategy.

• Duels – Classic 1v1 or 2v2 PvP battles to test your skills directly against opponents.
